Author: Susan K Fairchild, Camille M Easton
Summary: Beneath the glow of a full moon, magic stirs within an elementary school classroom: turkey hands, the colorful paper cut-outs pinned up for Thanksgiving, come whimsically to life! As moonlight fills the room, these crafty creations embark on a night filled with mischief and mayhem. They dive into glue, splatter ink, and even peck the alphabet off the walls in their playful spree. But carefree adventure takes a turn upon encountering the realities of the daytime world of teachers and students. Faced with the consequences of their nighttime antics, the turkey hands race against time to restore order to the classroom before the morning light reveals their secret lives. "The Turkey Hands" is a charming tale that mirrors the vibrant and often untidy journey of creativity in children. Much like children, the turkey hands can get carried away when having fun. No magic, only recognition and hard work, will get the turkey hands out of a mess of their own making.
Customer Reviews (Text): Customers find the book's illustrations gorgeous and appreciate it as a fun read-aloud. Moreover, the story receives positive feedback, with one customer noting how it encourages creativity and gratitude, while another mentions how it beautifully captures the spirit of Thanksgiving. Additionally, customers enjoy the humor, with one review mentioning how the turkeys in the book made them laugh.

Fairchild takes this beloved activity and turns it into a story about what those birds do at night after they are left in the classroom. With a mischievous flare and some surprising revelations, Fairchild has created a blast of a Thanksgiving story that will pair well with the art activity in Kindergarten and early elementary classrooms. Author: Cynthia Rylant, Jill Kastner
Categories (Amazon): Books > Children's Books > Early Learning > Basic Concepts > Seasons
Summary: In November, the air grows cold and the earth and all of its creatures prepare for winter. Animals seek food and shelter. And people gather together to celebrate their blessings with family and friends.  Cynthia Rylant's lyrical language and Jill Kastner's rich, cozy paintings capture the cherished moments of this autumn month--the moments we spend together and the ones we witness in the world around us.
